Title: Check the logo, username, password and Login button are visible on the login page
Expected Result: The logo, the username field, the password field and the Login button are visible.

Title: Check the password field hides the typed text
Test Steps: 1. Type any text in the password field.
Test Data: Any text typed in the password field
Expected Result: The typed text is hidden (the field type is password).

Title: Login with username "standard_user" and the correct password by clicking Login
Test Steps: 1. Type the username standard_user and the correct password. 2. Click Login.
Test Data: Username standard_user, the public demo password

Title: Login with username "standard_user" and the correct password by pressing Enter
Test Steps: 1. Type the username standard_user and the correct password. 2. Press Enter.
Test Data: Username standard_user, the public demo password

Title: Login with username "standard_user", then reload the page and stay logged in
Test Steps: 1. Login as standard_user. 2. Reload the page.
Test Data: Username standard_user, the public demo password
Expected Result: The products page is still shown (the user stays logged in).

Title: Login with username "standard_user", then log out from the menu and check the login page opens
Test Steps: 1. Login as standard_user. 2. Open the menu and click Logout.
Test Data: Username standard_user, the public demo password

Title: Login with the locked-out user "locked_out_user" and check the locked out message
Test Steps: 1. Type the username locked_out_user and the correct password. 2. Click Login.
Test Data: Username locked_out_user, the public demo password
Expected Result: The message "Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out." is shown and the user stays on the login page.

Title: Login with username "standard_user" and the wrong password "wrong_password"
Test Steps: 1. Type the username standard_user and the password wrong_password. 2. Click Login.
Expected Result: The message "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service" is shown and the user stays on the login page.

Title: Login with the unknown username "unknown_user" and a password
Test Steps: 1. Type the username unknown_user and a password. 2. Click Login.
Expected Result: The message "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service" is shown.

Title: Click Login with empty username and empty password
Test Steps: 1. Leave both fields empty. 2. Click Login.
Expected Result: The message "Epic sadface: Username is required" is shown.

Title: Click Login with username "standard_user" and empty password
Test Steps: 1. Type the username standard_user and leave the password empty. 2. Click Login.
Expected Result: The message "Epic sadface: Password is required" is shown.

Title: Login with the username in capital letters "STANDARD_USER" (username is case sensitive)
Test Steps: 1. Type the username STANDARD_USER and the correct password. 2. Click Login.
Test Data: Username STANDARD_USER (capital letters), the public demo password
Expected Result: The "do not match" message is shown (the username is case sensitive).

Title: Login with SQL injection text "' OR '1'='1" as the username
Test Steps: 1. Type ' OR '1'='1 as the username and the correct password. 2. Click Login.
Test Data: Username ' OR '1'='1, the public demo password
Expected Result: The "do not match" message is shown and the user stays on the login page.

Title: Close the error message with the X button and check the message disappears
Test Steps: 1. Click Login with empty fields. 2. Click the X button of the error message.

Title: Open /inventory.html without login and check the "must be logged in" message
Test Steps: 1. Open /inventory.html directly in the address bar.
Expected Result: The login page opens with the message "Epic sadface: You can only access '/inventory.html' when you are logged in."
